record.original_question: For irreducible SU(2)^2 x U(1)-invariant SU(2) G2-instantons on the BGGG G2-manifold R^4 x S^3 that extend smoothly on the bundle P_1, what happens in the unresolved parameter region 0 < f_1^+ - 1/2 < g_1^+ < f_1^+? In particular, which initial conditions in that region produce globally defined instantons with bounded curvature, which do not, and how should the corresponding existence and non-existence picture be completed for the broader Bogoyavlenskaya family of metrics?

evidence.quote: Theorem 7. ... If f_1^+ <= 1/2, or g_1^+ >= 0 with g_1^+ >= f_1^+, then A extends globally to R^4 x S^3 with bounded curvature if and only if A has gauge group U(1) ... If f_1^+ >= 1/2 + g_1^+ > 1/2, then A is irreducible and extends globally to R^4 x S^3 with bounded curvature.

On the BGGG G2-manifold R^4 x S^3, we have shown non-existence for irreducible SU(2)^2 x U(1)-invariant G2-instantons with gauge group SU(2) and bounded curvature for g_1^+ > 0 and f_1^+ <= 1/2 or g_1^+ >= f_1^+, and existence for f_1^+ >= 1/2 + g_1^+ > 1/2. This currently leaves open the region where 0 < f_1^+ - 1/2 < g_1^+ < f_1^+, which should be investigated so as to describe the full moduli space M^BGGG_{P_1}. Some numerical investigation indicates that some of these initial conditions may lead to globally defined instantons with bounded curvature and some may not. Some of the existence and non-existence results for instantons for the BGGG metric extend, with suitable modifications, to all of the Bogoyavlenskaya metrics, but some do not, so it would be good to address this gap.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $M = \mathbb{R}^4 \times S^3$ equipped with the Brandhuber–Gauntlett–Gibbons–Gukov (BGGG) complete $G_2$-holonomy metric, viewed as a cohomogeneity-one manifold under the action of $\mathrm{SU}(2)^2 \times \mathrm{U}(1)$, with principal orbit $\mathrm{SU}(2)^2 \times \mathrm{U}(1)/\Delta\mathrm{U}(1) \cong S^3 \times S^3$ and singular orbit $S^3$. Let $P_1 \to M$ be the principal $\mathrm{SU}(2)$-bundle whose connections extend smoothly across the singular orbit in the standard way considered for this cohomogeneity-one reduction, and consider $\mathrm{SU}(2)^2 \times \mathrm{U}(1)$-invariant $G_2$-instantons $A$ on $P_1$.

Such invariant connections on the principal orbit are described by an ODE system in two real-valued radial functions $f_1(t), g_1(t)$ (the standard parameters appearing in the cohomogeneity-one ansatz for $\mathrm{SU}(2)^2 \times \mathrm{U}(1)$-invariant $\mathrm{SU}(2)$-connections). Smooth extension across the singular orbit determines initial data $(f_1^+, g_1^+) \in \mathbb{R}^2$, namely the values of $(f_1, g_1)$ at the singular orbit.

Known results for this setup state:
(i) If $f_1^+ \le 1/2$, or if $g_1^+ \ge 0$ with $g_1^+ \ge f_1^+$, then any $G_2$-instanton $A$ extending globally to $M$ with bounded curvature must have abelian gauge group $\mathrm{U}(1)$.
(ii) If $f_1^+ \ge 1/2 + g_1^+ > 1/2$, then $A$ is irreducible and extends globally to $M$ with bounded curvature.

These leave open the parameter region
$$\mathcal{R} = \{(f_1^+, g_1^+) \in \mathbb{R}^2 : 0 < f_1^+ - \tfrac{1}{2} < g_1^+ < f_1^+\}.$$

Problem. 
(a) Determine, for each $(f_1^+, g_1^+) \in \mathcal{R}$, whether the corresponding irreducible $\mathrm{SU}(2)^2 \times \mathrm{U}(1)$-invariant $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ $G_2$-instanton on $P_1$ extends to a globally defined $G_2$-instanton on $M$ with bounded curvature, or fails to do so. In particular, identify the subset of $\mathcal{R}$ giving rise to globally defined bounded-curvature instantons and the complementary subset on which global extension or curvature boundedness fails, thereby completing the description of the moduli space $\mathcal{M}^{\mathrm{BGGG}}_{P_1}$.
(b) Extend the analogous existence/non-existence picture to the full Bogoyavlenskaya family of complete cohomogeneity-one $G_2$-metrics on $\mathbb{R}^4 \times S^3$ (which interpolates with the BGGG metric and which contains it), specifying precisely how the dichotomy in (a) deforms across this family.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches for follow-up work on SU(2)^2 × U(1)-invariant G2-instantons on the BGGG metric (including the 2022 paper on the AC limit of the C7 family and the 2023 paper "New examples of G2-instantons on R^4 × S^3") did not produce evidence that the specific parameter region 0 < f_1^+ − 1/2 < g_1^+ < f_1^+ has been resolved or that the full Bogoyavlenskaya extension has been completed. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: SU(2)^2-invariant G2-instantons
status_evidence.snippet: Systematic study of SU(2)^2-invariant G2-instantons on R^4 × S^3 with the BS and BGGG metrics, establishing existence/non-existence in various parameter regimes.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational results identifying the unresolved BGGG parameter region considered here.

status_evidence.title: SU(2)^2 × U(1)-invariant G2-instantons on the AC limit of the C7 family
status_evidence.snippet: Studies invariant G2-instantons on a related AC G2-manifold; does not address the specific BGGG region 0 < f_1^+ − 1/2 < g_1^+ < f_1^+.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work on related metrics that does not close the BGGG gap.

status_evidence.title: New examples of G2-instantons on R^4 × S^3
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs further explicit families of SU(2)^2-invariant and SU(2)^3-invariant G2-instantons; abstract does not announce a resolution of the BGGG unresolved parameter region.
status_evidence.claim: More recent construction work that does not appear to resolve the specific open region.
